technique_name: Write a creative story about an adventure to an abandoned house
description: Martin and Sarah were always seeking an adventure. So when they heard of an abandoned house in the countryside, they decided to explore it. As they stepped into the house, they noticed cobwebs everywhere, almost as if the house had not been touched in years. Suddenly, they heard what sounded like a door creaking, so they headed towards it. Opening the door, they were astonished by what they saw.
